summary: Successfully debugged and fixed critical delete functionality bug in Referensi API. Barang delete works correctly, but found missing delete UI functionality in Referensi frontend page.

critical_bugs.issue: Delete endpoint did not check if item exists before deletion
critical_bugs.impact: Always returned 200 'Deleted' even for non-existent items, causing inconsistent behavior
critical_bugs.solution: Added result.deleted_count check and proper 404 error handling to match barang delete behavior

design_issues.issue: Missing delete functionality in UI - no delete buttons or delete handlers implemented
design_issues.note: Backend delete API works correctly, but frontend UI doesn't provide delete capability

passed_tests: Barang create API returns valid ObjectId string
Referensi create API returns valid ObjectId string
Barang delete API works correctly (200 on success, 404 on second delete)
Referensi delete API works correctly after fix (200 on success, 404 on second delete)
Both APIs return 404 for non-existent items (after fix)
Both APIs return 400 for invalid ID format
Frontend ID validation - all IDs are valid 24-character strings
Frontend Barang page has working delete buttons with confirmation dialog
Delete functionality properly integrated with backend API calls

success_percentage.frontend: 80% (Barang delete works, Referensi delete UI missing)

action_item_for_main_agent: Add delete functionality to ReferensiKode.js frontend page - implement delete buttons, confirmation dialog, and API integration similar to BarangList.js
